poses.caption: Hold a straight plank with both hands on the stability ball and toes on the floor
Bend elbows to lower the chest toward the ball, keeping the body straight

jobs.detail: STABILITY BALL HANDS-SUPPORTED PUSH-UP, TWO phases. Same full-body three-quarter FRONT/SIDE camera head image LEFT feet RIGHT, one large round ribbed GRAY FULL SPHERE stability ball on floor under BOTH HANDS at image LEFT. This is a full round gym ball about55cm diameter, NOT a half dome, Bosu, bench or medicine ball. Both palms press upper sides of sphere shoulder-width apart, fingers spread securely over curved surface, no platform or handle. BOTH feet hip-width TOES on floor behind, knees STRAIGHT. LEFT HIGH: arms extended, body straight shoulder-hip-heel line from hands on ball to toes floor. RIGHT LOW: bend elbows about90degrees to lower CHEST toward TOP ball while keeping hips in line and knees straight, hands and ball remain same locations. Chest above ball not intersecting. Exactly2arms/2legs, same ball size/shape, no ball deformation or duplicates. Whole ball/person/fingers/shoes within white margins. Primary CHEST only smooth soft diffuse BLURRED red tint over continuous OPAQUE matte BLACK shirt, no pectoral subdivisions/fibers/starburst/cutaways. All exposed arms/legs fine detailed grayscale anatomical fibers. Full opaque black sleeveless shirt wraps torso front sides back and loose knee shorts wrap front sides back seat crotch. No text/arrows.
